title: i18n coverage: demand flows.FLOW.label for every embedded flow, not only the ones the walk reaches today
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35979 (PR #36383, step names of a flow translate). The PR's acceptance note 1 says the seat files this; the L2 review found no card. Filed by the seat. Parent: #35979.

## What happens

The translation-coverage walk demands `flows.FLOW_ID.label` only for the flows its predicate reaches today. A flow embedded elsewhere (an object's or app's bundled flows) can ship a drawn flow label with no translation asked for, so a zh-CN user sees the English flow name next to translated step names.

## To do

1. Census the flow-label readers and the places a flow can be declared (top level, object-embedded, app-bundled).
2. Widen the walk's flow-label predicate to every declared flow that a reader draws, in the same change as any reader it relies on (the walk's own rule: a string nobody reads is not demanded).
3. Re-baseline the coverage counts and say the rise in the changeset.

## Acceptance

- An embedded flow with a drawn label and no zh-CN entry is reported by the coverage check; a flow nobody draws is not.

Blocked-by: #36383

## Grade
p2 · area:i18n · domain:spec. Translation gap, not broken; every non-English user sees it on embedded flows.
